title: Facebook marketplace Scraper
description:
⚠️ Search results vary by proxy country and login status; set proxy country to your target region and use an incognito window to search and compare the results.

 ⚠️ Cookies are required to get seller information.

urls.title: Facebook marketplace URLs
urls.description: Search URLs (e.g. [marketplace search](https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/nyc/cars)) or individual listing URLs (e.g. https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/item/3195892660712281/). Open in incognito to verify accessibility. Optional if Filters are set.
urls.sectionDescription: Paste Marketplace search or listing URLs copied from Facebook. Use Filters below instead if you prefer to build a search from location, keyword, and radius.

searchKeyword.title: Search keyword
searchKeyword.description: Search term for Marketplace listings (e.g. couch, used bike).
searchKeyword.sectionDescription: Build a search from these filters. Filters are only used when no URLs are provided above; if you paste your own URLs, these are ignored and the URLs are scraped as-is.

location.title: Location
location.description: To avoid matching wrong locations with similar names use location in the format "City, State, Country" (e.g. "Los Angeles, California, United States", "Brooklyn, New York, United States"). Also supports postal codes. Resolved to exact coordinates via Facebook's location search. For full control, set Latitude/Longitude instead.

radiusKm.title: Radius (km)
radiusKm.description: This is always km regardless of region: Facebook's UI may display miles in mile-using regions (e.g. the US), but it converts to km for the request (selecting 80 miles becomes radius=128). So to target 80 miles, enter 128. Combine with Location (city name / postal code) or Latitude/Longitude.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Center latitude for Filters-based searches. When set with Longitude, overrides the Location field (location name lookup is skipped). Ignored if you paste URLs above. Set Longitude too.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Center longitude for Filters-based searches. Use together with Latitude (and optionally Radius) to target an exact area; overrides Location when both coordinates are set. Ignored if you paste URLs above.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order of the search results. Applies to Filters-based searches (ignored when you paste your own URLs).

minPrice.title: Min price
minPrice.description: Minimum listing price, in the searched location's local currency (e.g. a search in India filters in ₹). The currency follows the location, not the proxy region.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Maximum listing price, in the searched location's local currency (e.g. a search in India filters in ₹). The currency follows the location, not the proxy region.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Item condition(s) to include. Leave empty for any condition.

daysSinceListed.title: Date listed
daysSinceListed.description: Only include listings posted within this window.

deliveryMethod.title: Delivery method
deliveryMethod.description: Filter by how the item is delivered.

getListingDetails.title: Get listing details
getListingDetails.description: Scraper will visit details page and extract more information
getListingDetails.sectionDescription: Common options to apply for urls or filters based scraping

getAllListingPhotos.title: Get all listing photos
getAllListingPhotos.description: When get listing details is enabled, fetch listing media (images). Set to false to skip media API calls and reduce requests by ~33%

strictFiltering.title: Strict filtering
strictFiltering.description: Exclude listings that are broad matches (outside location, similar items, etc.)

maxPagesPerUrl.title: Max pages per URL
maxPagesPerUrl.description: Maximum number of search pages to scrape per search URL.

untilDate.title: Until date
untilDate.description: Scrape listings until this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only works if Get listing details is enabled and search url is sorted by newest first or url contains `sortBy=creation_time_descend`

proxy.title: Set proxy country
proxy.description: Set proxy country to your target marketplace region (e.g. US, IN, UK). Results depend on proxy region. Proxies are managed internally you only need to set proxy country in proxy input field.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description:
Facebook cookies for authenticated scraping. When provided, enables seller details scraping. Requires logged-in session cookies (`c_user` and `xs`). Accepts **Header string** (`name1=value1; name2=value2`) or **JSON** export. Concurrency is set to 1 and random delays are added when using cookies. Follow these steps to get the cookies:
  1. Install [Cookie-Editor](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/cookie-editor/hlkenndednhfkekhgcdicdfddnkalmdm) chrome extension
  2. Login to your facebook account
  3. Click on the extension icon > Export > Header string or JSON
  4. Paste the copied contents here

Video - How to get cookies (0:14)

onlyNewListings.title: Scrape only new or changed listings
onlyNewListings.description: Remember scraped search listings across runs and skip unchanged items before fetching their details. Listings are scraped again when their price, availability, or other visible search-result content changes.
onlyNewListings.sectionDescription:
This feature is currently restricted to high frequency runs scraping same search multiple times per day: Push only new or changed listings from the last 24 hours.

- **Billing**: Skipped unchanged listings are still charged as listing-item events, but are not written to the dataset.

- **Date listed must be Last 24 hours**: Filters: set **Date listed** to "Last 24 hours". URLs: Every search URL must include url parameter `daysSinceListed=1`.

- **Search only**: Individual listing URLs (`/marketplace/item/...`) are always scraped normally and are not covered by this feature.

- **Shared cache**: Uses a key-value store shared across runs.

- **Cache retention**: Listings not seen in search results for 24 hours are removed from the cache automatically.

cacheStorageId.title: Cache storage to use for existing listings
cacheStorageId.description: Key-value store shared by monitoring runs. Defaults to facebook-marketplace-listing-cache when empty. Use a separate store for each independent search/workflow so listings from different keywords or locations do not share one cache and get skipped
